**Job Title:** Sr. Software Engineer, Agents

**Team:** Engineering

**Location:** Onsite - Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica & West LA)

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Salary, Exempt

**Reports To:** Head of Engineering

### **About Plug**

Plug is the marketplace for used electric vehicles. Consumers get an instant cash offer backed by battery-health data, and dealers across the US bid in real time on that inventory. Former Tesla executives founded Plug in 2023. We’ve raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

### **Why Plug**

* You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
* You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
* You’ll be part of an AI-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level.
* You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
* You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes.

### **The Opportunity**

Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. What we need now is someone who can turn a stream of real operational problems into agents that work reliably, one after another.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Build and ship agents and multi-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling.
* Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them.
* Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible.
* Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them.
* Monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human-review rates. Fix what breaks and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time.
* Ship full-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them.
* Help the rest of engineering adopt the same patterns. Build reusable tools, examples, and short write-ups that make the next agent faster to build.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* 5+ years of full-time industry software engineering, with a track record of shipping features to production and supporting them after launch.
* Strong TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed.
* Hands-on experience building LLM features in production: tool use, retrieval, structured output, and above all, evaluation.
* Experience with an agent framework and observability stack, ideally LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse. If you’ve used something else, show us what you built and how you knew it worked.
* You work agent-first. You’ve built your own tooling around coding agents, such as skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals.
* Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan.
* A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up.
* You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit.
* High agency in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup. You find the most valuable workflow to automate and ship against it without waiting for a perfect spec.
* BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with document-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance.
* Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products.
* Experience with human-in-the-loop review tools, or with fine-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features.

### **Compensation and Benefits**

Annual salary: $175,000 to $200,000

Salary ranges come from independent, third-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes.

### **Benefits & Perks**

* Health, Vision, and Dental insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Daily lunch stipend
* Equity (based on role and performance)
* 30-day remote work from anywhere policy
* Unlimited PTO
* Fully stocked kitchen
* Dog-friendly office
* Ongoing opportunities for growth and development

This full-time position is an in-person role based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time.

**Acknowledgments**

Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. **About Newpage Solutions**

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview.

  

As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives.

  

**Your Mission**

We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built—not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.

You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.

This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.

**What You’ll Do**

**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

### **Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create full stack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, Fast API, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using Lang Graph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with Elasticsearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents—with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.
